summary: The University of Illinois Center for Advanced Computation proposes graphic display modes for its ARPANET node. Unlike other nodes, it was setting up a system for the ILLIAC IV and the network, so it was building its graphics system from scratch.

eli5.summary: A new lab that was not simply plugging an old computer into the network says what picture modes it wants to support.
